dialogues.en:
<$emotion(4,8)><$voicel(4,9)>I love how clean and comfy my shack is now. And it’s all
thanks to you, <$cdef(27)>!
<$emotion(4,29)><$voicel(4,5)>Any chance you can help with one last thing?

<$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,824)><$voicel(4,5)>You know how humans used to decorate their homes by
growing nice-smelling flowers outside?
<$voicel(4,7)>They put ’em in—whaddya call those things...
The fancy-lookin’ boxes where flowers grow?

<$emotion(4,37)><$voicel(4,9)>Yeah, that’s it—a <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1410)>! Wow, you know
everything, <$cdef(27)>!
<$motion(4,666)><$voicel(4,5)>I wanna get a <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1410)> for my shack. <$emotion(4,8)><$voicel(4,8)>Then I can spruce it
up by growing some flowers!
<$comeff(4,6)><$motion(4,666)><$voicel(4,5)>But wait... Don’t you need <$cdef(27)><fqty(2)><$ifull(105)></color> to make a <$cdef(27)><fqty(1)><$ifull(1410)></color>?

<$emotion(4,37)><$voicel(4,5)>We should ask <$cdef(27)><$cname(229)> for help. I bet they could make
those for us, no problem!
Well, ONE problem. <$voicel(4,1)><$emotion(4,31)>I haven’t seen <$cdef(27)><$cname(229)> around lately.
<$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,32)>They used to live in a place like this.

<$voicel(4,5)><$emotion(4,14)>If you run into <$cdef(27)><$cname(229)>, get ’em to make <$cdef(27)><$ifull(105)> for you!
<$voicel(4,3)><$emotion(4,65)>If you used those <$cdef(27)><$ifull(105)> to make a <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1410)> for my
shack and put some flowers in it...
<$voicel(4,9)><$emotion(4,98)><$facial(4,4)>That’d make me SUPER happy!

<$voicel(4,5)><$emotion(4,14)>If you run into <$cdef(27)><$cname(229)>, get ’em to make <$cdef(27)><$ifull(105)> for you!
<$voicel(4,3)><$emotion(4,65)>If you used those <$cdef(27)><$ifull(105)> to make a <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1410)> for my
shack and put some flowers in it...
<$voicel(4,9)><$emotion(4,98)>That’d make me SUPER happy!
<$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,666)><$voicel(4,5)>By the way, <$cdef(27)>Torchic</color> used to live in a spot like this.

<$emotion(4,29)><$voicel(4,7)>Hello, hello, <$cdef(27)>! Are you having
trouble
with something?

<$comeff(4,3)><$motion(4,805)><$voicel(4,9)>Ohhh, you wanna make a <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1410)>? Then you need
<$cdef(27)><$ifull(105)> first!

<$emotion(4,37)><$voicel(4,7)>I can make <$cdef(27)><$ifull(105)> with <$cdef(27)><$ifull(112)>! <$voicel(4,4)>I just bake the
clay with fire, like FWOOOOSH!
<$emotion(4,8)><$voicel(4,9)>I’m really good at it, so <$voicel(4,10)>I can make you some any time you
bring me <$cdef(27)><$ifull(112)>!

<$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,666)><$voicel(4,5)>There’s <$cdef(27)><$ifull(112)> in lotsa different places around
town if you look for it!

You can find <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1005)> blocks around town that look a bit
different from the rest of the ground.
If you break <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1005)> with <$cdef(27)><$sklfull(4)>, you’ll find
<$cdef(27)><$ifull(112)>!

<$emotion(4,14)><$voicel(4,7)>You made the <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1410)>! Woo-hoo! Thanks a bunch,
<$cdef(27)>! I knew I could count on you.

<$motion(4,806)><$voicel(4,5)>Now can you put that <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1410)> near my home <$emotion(4,29)><$voicel(4,8)>and
plant some flower seeds in it?
<$emotion(4,38)><$voicel(4,10)>This is gonna be great! I can’t wait to see those
flowers bloom!

Just as <$cdef(27)>Meowth said, you can plant seeds in <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1410)>!
Seeds take some time to bloom after you plant them, but
if you bring a Pokémon with the <$cdef(27)><$spwfull(5)> specialty to the
<$cdef(27)><$ifull(1410)>, they’ll speed up the growing process!

<$comeff(4,9)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,806)><$voicel(4,9)>Or you could find some flowers that are already growing
somewhere and replant them in the <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1410)>!
<$emotion(4,37)><$voicel(4,7)>But I dunno how to do fancy stuff like that.

<$emotion(4,60)><$voicel(4,9)>My little shack looks so fancy thanks to those pretty
flowers you planted, <$cdef(27)>!
<$emotion(4,8)><$voicel(4,7)>Thanks again for helpin’ me out with everything!

<$emotion(4,60)><$voicel(4,9)>I gotta say, <$cdef(27)>, you’re seriously
the awesomest!
<$comeff(4,9)><$motion(4,806)><$voicel(4,7)>If there’s ever anything I can do to help you out,
let me know, OK? I owe ya!

You can use <$cdef(27)><$sklfull(2)> to replant blooming flowers and
tall grass in a new location!

<$cdef(27)>Drilbur probably knows a lot about using <$cdef(27)><$sklfull(2)>!
You can find them at <$cdef(27)><$stgname;0(1)>.

<$comeff(4,14)><$voicel(4,5)>Now can you put that <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1410)> near my home <$emotion(4,29)><$voicel(4,8)>and
plant some flower seeds in it?
<$emotion(4,38)><$voicel(4,10)>This is gonna be great! I can’t wait to see those
flowers bloom!

<$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,666)><$voicel(4,5)>Or I guess you could dig up some of the flowers in bloom
around here and replant them in the <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1410)> instead...
<$emotion(4,51)><$voicel(4,4)>But I’ve got no clue how you’d even do that.

Just as <$cdef(27)>Meowth said, you can plant seeds in <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1410)>!
Seeds take some time to bloom after you plant them, but
if you bring a Pokémon with the <$cdef(27)><$spwfull(5)> specialty to the
<$cdef(27)><$ifull(1410)>, they’ll speed up the growing process!

You can also use <$cdef(27)><$sklfull(2)> to replant blooming
flowers and tall grass in a new location, like a <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1410)>!

<$cdef(27)>Drilbur probably knows a lot about using <$cdef(27)><$sklfull(2)>!
You can find them at <$cdef(27)><$stgname;0(1)>.

<$voicel(4,3)><$emotion(4,27)>You need <$cdef(27)><$ifull(105)> to make a <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1410)>? Gotcha!
<$voicel(4,9)><$emotion(4,8)>I can make <$cdef(27)><$ifull(105)> for you if you bring me some
<$cdef(27)><$ifull(112)>!

You can find <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1005)> blocks around town that look a bit
different from the rest of the ground.
If you break <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1005)> with <$cdef(27)><$sklfull(4)>, you’ll find
<$cdef(27)><$ifull(112)>!

<$emotion(4,14)><$voicel(4,7)>Oooh, you found some <$cdef(27)><$ifull(112)>! Then let’s get
started right away...
<$motion(4,850)><$voicel(4,10)>Ahhh... *FWOOSH!*

<$emotion(4,38)><$voicel(4,7)>Oh, it’ll take a little time before it’s all baked through!
You can do something else while you wait!
<$comeff(4,9)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,806)><$voicel(4,7)>The <$cdef(27)><fqty(2)><$ifull(105)></color>’ll be done soon! Wait just a little more!

<$emotion(4,37)><$voicel(4,9)>Sorry I made you wait, <$cdef(27)>! But I
finished
your
<$cdef(27)><$ifull(105)>!

<$voicel(4,5)><$emotion(4,8)>Now I bet you can make a <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1410)> with those <$cdef(27)><$ifull(105)>!
<$voicel(4,10)><$emotion(4,37)>You seem really good at stuff like that!

<$voicel(4,5)><$emotion(4,37)>You can use <$cdef(27)><$ifull(105)> to make all sortsa stuff besides
<$cdef(27)><$ifull(1410)>, too!
<$voicel(4,9)><$emotion(4,39)>If you ever need more, just bring me some
<$cdef(27)><$ifull(112)>, ’kay?

<$emotion(4,29)><$voicel(4,7)><$cdef(27)>! Yooo,
<$cdef(27)>!
Hey,
do
you
have
a minute?
<$emotion(4,38)><$voicel(4,10)>I just remembered somethin’ I wanted to ask you about.

<$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,827)><$voicel(4,6)>So y’see this tall, thin thing here?
<$voicel(4,7)>I seem to remember the tip of it always bein’ lit up real
pretty, yo...

<$voicel(4,5)>I always really liked that, y’know? So I’ve been waitin’ for
it to light up...<$emotion(4,31)><$voicel(4,4)>but it’s just stayin’ dark. <$emotion(4,29)><$voicel(4,6)>Do ya think it might
be broken?

<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,5)>Ah yes, this is something the humans made to illuminate
the town. <$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,8)>It’s called a <$cdef(27)>streetlight.
<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,5)>And just as you say, <$cdef(27)>Trubbish, these contraptions were
meant to shine with a beautiful light... <$comcan(1)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,4)>But for that,
I believe we need electricity.
<$motion(4,806)><$voicel(4,5)>Yooo... Electricity, huh? That makes sense.

<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,5)>If we had a Pokémon with us who could generate
electricity, they might be able to light up this <$cdef(27)>streetlight,
<$voicel(1,8)>just like the old days...

<$comcan(1)><$comeff(4,14)><$voicel(4,6)>A Pokémon who can generate electricity... <$comeff(4,20)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,7)>Oh! Yooo!
I think I might know one!
<$comeff(4,6)><$motion(4,666)><$voicel(4,5)>I bet <$cdef(27)>Pawmi </color>could generate some electricity for us!
<$emotion(4,37)><$voicel(4,9)>And I seem to remember them livin’ in a place like this, yo!

<$emotion(4,8)><$voicel(4,9)>I sure would love to see the <$cdef(27)>streetlight shinin’ bright
again, yo...
<$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,666)><$voicel(4,5)>I bet <$cdef(27)>Pawmi </color>could generate some electricity for us!
<$emotion(4,37)><$voicel(4,9)>I seem to remember them livin’ in a place like this, yo.
<$emotion(4,38)><$voicel(4,10)>Yoooooo! It lit up! It’s so pretty!

<$comeff(4,9)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,806)><$voicel(4,7)>Ahhh... I dunno why, but gazin’ at that light sure does
make me feel relaxed...
<$emotion(1,1)><$voicel(1,7)>Indeed! This ought to brighten up the town a bit!

<$emotion(4,38)><$voicel(4,9)>Being able to generate electricity is pretty dang awesome!
Respect, yo! Seriously!

<$emotion(4,50)><$voicel(4,7)>You’re pretty awesome too, <$cdef(27)>!
<$emotion(4,38)><$voicel(4,9)>Thanks to you two, I can finally have this beautiful light
in my life again!

<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)><$cdef(27)>! Why don’t you try lighting up
other
<$cdef(27)>streetlights too?
<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,9)>That should brighten up the town even more!

<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,6)>Say, <$cdef(27)>. It looks like more
Pokémon
have
come
back
to
live
in
this
place too!

<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,7)>Yes! I’m really quite impressed! The town’s gotten much
livelier too.
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,9)>At this point, I want to see some houses!

<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,5)>If you build some nice houses for Pokémon to live in, <$voicel(1,7)>this
place ought to feel even more like it did when humans
were still around.

<$emotion(1,37)><$voicel(1,9)>You’re always so dependable, <$cdef(27)>!
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>So you’ll start by building a house for Pokémon to live in?
<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,8)>I’m looking forward to it!

<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,7)>Now that there are so many Pokémon around here, I’m
sure it’s doable!
<$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Do you think you could work together with the others to
build a house for Pokémon to live in? <$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,8)>I’d be much obliged!
<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,7)>I hope you can build a nice house for Pokémon to live in.
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,5)>Oh, and don’t forget to put some furniture inside!

<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,7)>Have you made any Pokémon houses
yet, <$cdef(27)>?

<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,824)><$voicel(1,5)>If you build houses and have Pokémon live in them,
<$voicel(1,7)>I believe this place will feel much more like it did back
when there were still humans around. <$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,10)>I know you can do it!
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,7)>Oh, and don’t forget to put furniture in those houses!

<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,9)>Oho! You’ve built a mighty fine house! I’m sure any
Pokémon who gets the chance to live here will be thrilled!

<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,7)>It would warm this old heart if you could carry on making
more houses for Pokémon to live in.

<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,10)>Right! That’s the helpful <$cdef(27)>
I know!
<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,7)>I believe Pokémon’s <$cdef(27)>comfort levels will improve greatly if
they’re living in houses.
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,10)>I look forward to seeing what you make next!

<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,9)>Hohoho! Fair enough! I’ll leave the timing and details up
to you.
<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,7)>I believe Pokémon’s <$cdef(27)>comfort levels will improve greatly if
they’re living in houses.
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,10)>I look forward to seeing what you do
next, <$cdef(27)>!
<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,7)>Oh, <$cdef(27)><pname;0></color>, do you have a moment?

<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,824)><$voicel(1,5)>We certainly have a lot more Pokémon around here
now—thanks to you, of course!
<$voicel(1,7)>But different Pokémon have so many conflicting tastes...
Not just about objects but about their environment too.
<$emotion(1,51)><$voicel(1,5)>So, it’s been nagging me... Are all the Pokémon really
comfortable here?

If it’s nagging at you too, try checking the <$cdef(27)>environment
level at the <$cdef(27)>Pokémon Center PC!
The <$cdef(27)>environment level increases as more Pokémon arrive
and as their individual <$cdef(27)>comfort levels increase.
If the <$cdef(27)>environment level hasn’t increased in a while, then
there may be some Pokémon who are dissatisfied with
their<$cdef(27)> comfort levels!
At times like that, talk with various Pokémon and try to
improve their <$cdef(27)>comfort levels!

<$cdef(27)>Professor Tangrowth will definitely feel reassured if the
<$cdef(27)>environment level reaches at least level <$cdef(27)>three!

<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,7)>Hm? It seems you’ve got a plan!
<$voicel(1,5)>I take it you’re willing to adjust the environment
around here <$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,8)>so lots of Pokémon can live happily
together?

<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,9)><$voicel(1,5)>The main thing that’s bothering me is just how drearily
dark it is...
<$emotion(1,51)><$voicel(1,3)>No thanks to all those heavy clouds constantly looming
overhead. It always feels like nighttime in this town.
<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,7)>I’d wager that quite a few Pokémon would be pleased
indeed if you brightened this place up a bit more.
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,5)>And, naturally, there must be other ways to improve the
environment as well.
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,10)>It’s up to you how you’d like to go about it!

<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,3)>I can’t help wondering if all the Pokémon are feeling
comfortable here...

<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,9)>I’m counting on you to adjust the environment around here
so everyone can live together happily!

<$cdef(27)>Professor Tangrowth will definitely feel reassured if the
<$cdef(27)>environment level reaches at least level <$cdef(27)>three!

The <$cdef(27)>environment level increases as more Pokémon arrive
and as their individual <$cdef(27)>comfort levels increase.
If the <$cdef(27)>environment level hasn’t increased in a while, then
there may be some Pokémon who are dissatisfied with
their<$cdef(27)> comfort levels!
At times like that, talk with various Pokémon and try to
improve their <$cdef(27)>comfort levels!

<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,8)>Oho, <$cdef(27)>!
<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,9)>Everyone seems heaps happier now—I think they can feel
how much the environment has improved!
<$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,8)>I believe we have you to thank for that!

<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,9)>But I hope you’ll keep working to make this place an even
more comfortable place for everyone to live.
<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,7)>I truly believe doing that may cause the humans to
come back someday!

<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>I do still wonder, though... Will these dark clouds ever
dissipate?

<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,7)>Oho, <$cdef(27)>! There’s something I’ve
been
meaning
to say!

<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Well, the Pokémon population has boomed in this
town too. You know that’s thanks to you, right?
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,824)><$voicel(1,7)>Different Pokémon have different likes and dislikes, and
even prefer a variety of different environments...
<$voicel(1,10)>But everyone seems reasonably content here nonetheless!

<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Oh, certainly! The Pokémon population has boomed in this
town too. You do know that’s thanks to you?
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,824)><$voicel(1,7)>Different Pokémon have different likes and dislikes, and
even prefer a variety of different environments...
<$voicel(1,10)>But everyone seems reasonably content here nonetheless!

<$voicel(1,5)>You must really be working hard to make that happen. <$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,8)>So,
I just wanted to take a moment to thank you once again.
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,9)>I hope you’ll continue making this an even more
pleasant place for Pokémon to live!

The <$cdef(27)>environment level is increasing nicely!

and as their individual <$cdef(27)>comfort levels increase.
If the <$cdef(27)>environment level hasn’t increased in a while, then

<$cdef(27)>PC at a <$cdef(27)>Pokémon Center!
You came up with a <$cdef(27)>recipe</color> for a <$cdef(27)><fqty(1)><$ifull(1410)></color>!

<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,5)>Huh? You already have some <$cdef(27)><$ifull(112)>? <$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,8)>Then do
you want me to make some <$cdef(27)><$ifull(105)> right now?
<$emotion(4,50)><$voicel(4,5)>OK! Here I go!
<$motion(4,850)><$voicel(4,10)>Ahhh... *FWOOSH!*

<$emotion(4,38)><$voicel(4,7)>Oh, it’ll take a little time before it’s all baked through!
You can do something else while you wait!

<$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,666)><$voicel(4,5)>This tall, thin thing is all lit up and pretty! The light makes
me feel, like, calm and peaceful ’n’ stuff...

<$comcan(4)><$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,824)><$voicel(1,5)>Yes, this was made by humans to light up the town. <$voicel(1,8)>It’s
called a <$cdef(27)>streetlight.
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>But I seem to recall it was dark when we arrived in
this town...
<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,9)>A Pokémon who can use electricity must have lit it up!

<$emotion(4,38)><$voicel(4,9)>I seeee... Bein’ able to generate electricity sounds wild, yo!
<$comeff(4,21)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,8)>Like, major respect to any Pokémon who can do that!

<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,5)><$cdef(27)>, if you find any streetlights that
are
still
dark,
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,7)>why
not
try
lighting
them
up?
Maybe with the help of another Pokémon?
<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,9)>That ought to brighten this town up considerably!
